# Changelog

## Unreleased

- Added the three fixture roots under `test/fixtures/`.
- Generated the binary fixtures byte by byte rather than committing files from
  unknown sources.

## 0.2.0 — 2026-08-18

- Folder listings are generated when a folder has neither `index.md` nor
  `README.md`. Try [the reference folder](./reference/).
- Relative links now resolve against the containing file, not the root.

## 0.1.0 — 2026-08-04

- First working read-only server.

See also [contributing](./contributing.md).
